test_title: PYST 193: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 9th Nov, 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e23db807fec4bdb3999dc28b0630dd3f0aa9af5ab8aba75816cb492e96788805.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is as shown below :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cbf6524af540035ed8d12a17b62995491daa4d6bf9934386f1ae42904d21220c.png] →** (a × b) - c = d**

Similarly,

1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8698c74ff65b8cc51efc03830a960d3494d043b2a843d68ef1ef2714e1f21b3.png] → (7 × 5) - 11 = 35 - 11 = 24

2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cfd739ef53bd9c3151559f59b6b80ee3b8e6e353917fcdcb21e414be3e2aecf9.png] → (9 × 8) - 15 = 72 - 15 = 57

3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91a91353a26ab293424f2ad700e3ddd41cfa211d835274d283085955c79a1fc8.png] → (12 × 3) - 3 = 36 - 3 = 33

4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9464028fba0bc5baeb9f9f43b288c4eba9cbacd834d439382995422a69f2f57.png] → **(13 × 7) - 21 = 91 - 21 = 70**

Hence, the correct answer is **"70".**
